model.title: A resolution designating August 21, 2026, as "Fentanyl Prevention and Awareness Day".

summary.text: The resolution designates August 21, 2026, as Fentanyl Prevention and Awareness Day. It encourages people across the United States to promote prevention of illicit fentanyl use and to teach young people about it on that day, as a symbol of commitment to a healthy, drug-free lifestyle. It also encourages children, teenagers, and other individuals to choose to live drug-free lives, and encourages people to support drug prevention efforts and the creation of drug-free communities.
